meta.name: deeptools
meta.description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将高通量测序数据转化为可视化分析图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在分析ChIP-seq、RNA-seq或ATAC-seq数据
copy.tagline_en: Transform high-throughput sequencing data into visualization and analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if analyzing ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, or ATAC-seq data

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会调用 deepTools 命令行工具来处理高通量测序数据：把 BAM 转成 bigWig 覆盖率文件，做质控（相关性、PCA、指纹图），并围绕 TSS 或峰区生成热图和剖面图，适用 ChIP-seq、RNA-seq、ATAC-seq 等。
howto.when: 用户要求转换 BAM 到 bigWig、做质控（如相关性、指纹图）、生成热图/剖面图，或分析 ChIP-seq、RNA-seq、ATAC-seq 数据时触发。

say.text: 把 sample.bam 转成 bigWig 文件
比较处理组和对照组的信号
say.note: 会调用 bamCompare 输出 log2 比值图。

say.text: 画基因 TSS 周围的热图

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run deepTools commands to handle sequencing data: convert BAM to bigWig coverage, run QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprint), and generate heatmaps/profiles around TSS or peaks, for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq.
howto.when_en: Triggers when users ask for BAM-to-bigWig conversion, QC (e.g., correlation, fingerprint), heatmap/profile plots, or analysis of ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq data.

say_en.note: Runs bamCoverage to generate normalized bigWig.
Calls bamCompare to output log2 ratio track.

say_en.text: Plot a heatmap around gene TSS.
